meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: "All Vendors": "Cancel" closes it and changes nothing
gaps: Verify that the event status, times, vendors, and bids are unchanged before and after cancelling the All Vendors window.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the event status, times, vendors, and bids are unchanged before and after cancelling the All Vendors window.

steps.note: Open the Events list to reach the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab required by the case.
Open the draft event shown in the Drafts list.
Open the Participants window on the saved draft.
Confirm that the All Vendors window opened.
Cancel the All Vendors window as required by the case.
Verify that cancelling closed the All Vendors window.
Confirm that cancelling did not produce an application error.
